book.title: Xoulek Nimza wei Matai byex o

content: Tambiy Ngandoung wei Sabat o
Lek bouk wei Sabat eno Yesu la eivek xuk wei wit. E xe xel betiyeing maxepya xel om xel embei qou wit lu valu me gya.
Xel Parisi yei tine, eno xel neil wou e, “Wei! Wa xe xel betiyeing di wong vati wei se la teyei lek petieing o lek bouk wei Sabat o.”
Moxo lewexe, “Beip xam seng pyaw vati wei Dawit wong gyeik ingwei e me e xe xel wei mi la is eno maxepya xel o?
Om Dawit la eivek xomek wei Anutu xe yo, de e me e xe xel wei mi la is e yo ya belet wei vambuing wei xel peti yo, en inyon xel lumuki venaxow xe.
O xam seng pyaw eivek qapiya wei petieing o, bei lek Sabat eno xel lumuki wei mi wo xuk eivek xomek vambuing eno pyalek petieing wei Sabat o, eno se wo sewokeing?
A neil wou xam bei tiwei toundei inye eno ghanaw xomek vambuing.
Wangwei xam ghe boulek qayeeng tine qes,

content.text: “‘A laleing vind lalei pyaweingxow, de se seing xound,’ Hosea 6:6

content: xam seng teyei bei toung nimaying lek xel wei se wo sewokeing o.
En Xomaxoneing Neu Moux on Tambiy Ngandoung wei Sabat o.”
Yesu la veil beyeeng tiyon, me la eivek xel xe xomek qekueing ama,

me tambiy wei mema bezomb eno ti toundei inyon. Xel di yimexe qayeeng qes wei xel embei bong qayeeng en Yesu yo, om xel teling wou e, “Beip inyei teyei lek bei xey a bong xel wei vanei eno bo nimzalek Sabat, o ma?”
Moxo neil wou xel, “Wangwei xam ti xe sipsip ti deteina eivek leiveeng lek Sabat, tyek wa seng na zeim e me na puw e nam myayaing?
Xel xomaxoneing on ghanaw sipsip veil! Omva petieing neil embei xey a bong kwa nimza lek Sabat.”
Woyom moxo neil wou tambiy on, “Tatei memam.” Om moxo tatei mema de mema wo nimza no, nambei mema nge.
Ekom xel Parisi la myayaing me luk wouma bei tyek xel nyeis Yesu nambei nya.
Anutu xe xukxe wei beyal o
Om Yesu la veil beyeeng tiyon, en woulek vati wei xel Parisi embei bo wou e yo. Xel ngenong betiwou e, me moxo wong xel dalus xe vanei ma,
de peti xel bei eti se neil e teyei bei e eti.
Kwa tine la teyei lek vati wei Anutu neil eivek poropet Yesaya mya yo.

content.text: “Wei, inye a xe xukxe tiwei a beyal o,
a laleing vind e me na wo xeinglala en e.
Tyek a toung a xe Laweeng lek e,
me moxo tyek baluk en kwa bombek wei moux alis vex wei tembuing sapa yo.
Tyek moxo se neil qayeeng is lalei vanei me taxe niseikeing,
me xelti tyek se ngo e vya eivek sakwaing mema nayak on.
Wangwei ghet na pyaw nayaka eno tyek se pyaw veil,
me wangwei lam bo lu bandaing tyek moxo se nyeis lam amey,
qe ka e menyex wou sakwaing bombek me e bo neing lek.
Eivek e lei eno xomaxoneing eivek tembuing bamba tyek na toung mend en e.” Yesaya 42:1-4

content: Yesu me Belsebul
Woyom xel qou tambiy wei memo wong e ma tuzeyi me myatu yo me lam wou Yesu, me e wong moxo wo nimzalek, en kandek moxo teyei bei baluk me gyeina.
Xomaxoneing dalus etek me neil, “Beip inye Dawit Neu Moux?”
Ekom gyeik xel Parisi ngo tine, xel neil, “Tambiy tine mi tiy memo en nikanzek wei Belsebul o, lukanzek wei xel memo yo.”
Yesu woulek xel xe woueing nalei om neil wou xel, “Tete lalei dalus wei dembuma yo tyek bo nol wouma, me beyeeng ngandoung o xomek ti dembuma on tyek se bale nikanzek.
Wangwei Sandang na tiy Sandang na veil, on moxo dembu venaxow. Woyom nambei nya moxo xe tete lalei tyek bale nikanzek?

Me wangwei a tiy memo na veil angya Belsebul nikanzek nei, ond eti mi vind xel wei xam o me xel mi tiy memo yon la myayaing? Om xel wei xam eno tyek talex wou xam bei qayeeng wei xam on se la wo bombek.
Ekom wangwei a tiy memo yon na veil nangya Anutu xe Laweeng, woyom Anutu xe tete lalei eno lam wou xam woy.
“Nambei nya tambiy ti teyei bei na eivek tambiy wei nikanzek o beeng me na qou e xe lulul, ka e tup tambiy nikanzek on bole? Woyom e teyei bei na panax lulul eivek e xe xomek.
“Moux wei se mindei is ay, eno inye mi wo vevek wou ay, de tambiy wei se mi qekuwou moux alis vex is ay eno mi tiy xel lala.

Om a neil wou xam bei, sewokeing tambak me qayeeng lukeingyak wei xomaxoneing mi wong eno Anutu teyei bei semaleeng veil, ekom tambiy ti embei baluk yak lek Laweeng Vambuing eno e xe nilul on tyek se semaleeng veil.

Tambiy ti embei baluk qayeeng nilul lek Xomaxoneing Neu Moux on tyek semaleeng veil, ekom xelti embei baluk nilul lek Laweeng Vambuing on tyek nilul wei e yon se teyei bei semaleeng veil, eivek bouk tine me bouk loxyus wei di lam o is.
“Wangwei xax on nimza, ond tyek neing on bo nimza is, o wangwei xax on bo nilul on tyek neing on bo nol is ambei nyon, en xel mi woulek xax lek e neing.
Xam on myeiy nilul neuyeiw, nambei nya tyek xam baluk qayeeng nimza? En qayeeng mi lam veil xomaxoneing laleind me xel myend mi luk.
Xomaxoneing wei nimza eno tyek bo lulul nimza wei mindei eivek e lalei yo, dom xomaxoneing wei nilul eno tyek bo lul wei nilul wei toundei eivek e yo nam myayaing.
Ekom a neil wou xam bei gyeik Anutu embei daxe xomaxoneing, xel eti yeiw wei mi neil qayeeng bandabanda dalus eno xel a tul pavulek wei xel o teyei.
En wamaxow xe qayeeng eno tyek Anutu na neimbei wa bombek, de wamaxow xe qayeeng eno tyek na neimbei wa tambiy nilul.”
Dee wei Yona yo
Woyom xel Parisi valu me putoung wei petieing o neil wou Yesu, “Putoung, xa bei ghei dee wei lulvako valu wou wang.”
Moxo lewexe, “Xel moux alis vex nilul wei bouk tine wei mi toung demind wou Anutu yo eno mi teling en dee wei lulvako! Ekom xel se teyei bei gyei dee ti, qe tyek xel gyei dee wei poropet Yona yo.
En Yona toundei bendiyeing yal me boukeing yal eivek woing ngandoung on bambou, om Xomaxoneing Neu Moux tyek mendei bendiyeing yal me boukeing yal eivek tembuing lalei.

Lek bouk wei ngoeing qayeeng eno xel wei Niniwe tyek qandi me bale me bo qayeeng en xomaxoneing wei gweimbeeng ne me na neil xel xe nilul teyei, en xel pekwi xow gyeik ingwei Yona la neil xoulek o. Wei, gweimbeeng tambiy ti ghanaw Yona veil, eno lam toundei inye.

Kwin wei xonei eno tyek nam bale lek qayeeng is xel wei gweimbeeng ne me bo qayeeng en xel, en vexo lam anghei tembuing myasepu bei nam a ngo Salomo xe kwa nimza. De gweimbeeng ne tambiy ti ghanaw Salomo eno lam toundei inye.
Laweeng nilaxes loumelam no
“Gyeik laweeng nilaxes lam myayaing veil xomaxoneing ti, eno la eivek beyeeng bandaing me yimexe beyeeng wei embei na qou laweeng o ekom se yeiwou ti.
Woyom neil, ‘Tyek a nox mena beyeeng wei a ghanaw o.’ Gyeik e lam tyip me yei xomek wei xelti se qou yo. Eno xel pepa e wo vako me vunekwou e wo nimza.

Woyom moxo la me qou laweeng lim yuw ba wei nilul ayang ghanaw e yo, me xel la lalei me dei inyon. Om tambiy tiyon xe deing wo nilul ghanaw ingwei mindei tax o. Inyon tyek bong ambei kayon wou xel nilul wei gweimbeeng ne yo.”
Yesu ta me liyeiw
Gyeik Yesu di luk is xel qendu yon, moxo ta me liyeiw moux toukale myayaing, en xel embei baluk is e.
Xel ti neil wou e, “Wa tam me limyeiw moux lam toukale myayaing, en xel embei baluk is wang.”
Yesu neil elox wou e, “A tang eti, me a lingyeiw eti?”
Om seloung mema la wou e xe betiyeingyeiw, me neil, “Inye a tang me a lingyeiw moux.
En eti yeiw wei mi betiwou Mang wei toundei eivek tyoung gheyapu yo lalei yond inyon a ling moux me a ling vex me a tang.”
